sentences.japanese: 空港につくとすぐに彼は妻に電話した。
sentences.english: Upon arriving at the airport, he made a phone call to his wife.

sentences.japanese: 去年、妻を亡くしたんだ。
sentences.english: I lost my wife last year.

sentences.japanese: 休暇のプランについて妻と私の意見は一致した。
sentences.english: My wife and I agreed on a holiday plan.

sentences.japanese: 我々の文化では、男は一度にひとりの妻としか結婚できない。
sentences.english: In our culture, a man is allowed to be married to only one wife at a time.

sentences.japanese: 妻は今、夕食の準備をしている。
sentences.english: My wife is preparing dinner right now.
